out.title: V. N. Srivatsan appointed Chief Compliance Officer
out.summary: V. N. Srivatsan assumed office as Chief Compliance Officer on November 6, 2026, for a three-year term, joining Senior Management; previously Head of Compliance at ICICI Bank.

person.name: V. N. Srivatsan
person.bio: ~34 years' experience, ~25 in BFSI, ~10 in compliance/regulatory inspection; previously Head – Compliance, Overseas Banking and Subsidiaries & Data Privacy Officer at ICICI Bank.
